title: Unlock Apollo’s Potential: Join & Build Cardano’s Golang Library

ms.promise:
・Rewrite critical sections of the Apollo library to achieve high performance, focusing on optimizing transaction-building speed.
・Implement comprehensive error handling and logging mechanisms for all major functions, ensuring robustness and clarity.
・Add support for UTxO RPC blockchain explorer and ensure seamless integration.
ms.criteria:
・Performance benchmarks demonstrate improvements in transaction building, including metrics such as transactions built per second (tx/s).
・Comprehensive error handling and logging mechanisms are implemented and verified across all major functions.
・Integration and verification of UTxO RPC blockchain explorer with successful test cases confirming full functionality.
ms.report:
The performance benchmarks demonstrate improvement and the comprehensive error handling and logging mechanisms have been implemented. Successful test cases confirm the integration and verification of UTxO RPC. 
The evidence of milestone completion:
・Performance test result demonstrating improved transaction-building speed, including metrics such as transactions per second (tx/s). Results. Reference the Script used. 
・A public URL to the implemented error handling and logging codebase. All available on GitHub: Release v1.1.1 Comprising of the work in PR #64 and PR #65
・A recorded video demonstration presents proof of successful transactions performed using the UTxO RPC blockchain explorer. https://youtu.be/iLubVJ1lHHU

Evidence for Output 1: Link to a GitHub pull request showing the successful integration of dRep functionality: Pull Request 202 Apollo now includes Conway-era / CIP-1694 DRep certificate builder support, including `RegisterDRep`, `RetireDRep`, and `UpdateDRep`.

Output 2: Link to a GitHub pull request showing the successful integration of dRep functionality.

ms.report:
We improved Apollo as a developer focused Go library for Cardano by expanding its transaction building, smart contract, staking, data attachment, explorer integration and governance capabilities.
The closeout report including links to github for pull requests and documentation along with video evidence: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1jMERp3sQGmZDrYHnHLQ44FOH16hpPH92/view?usp=sharing 
The closeout video that reviews the entire project from start to finish: https://youtu.be/bhlfdEgNylI
